name: open-a11y-portal
description: Free, self-hosted portal for accessibility problem reports. Runs on Cloudflare Workers and D1.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file seed/dev.sql
scripts.deploy: node scripts/upgrade-config.mjs && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Email addresses that can log in to your portal, separated by commas. For example: you@yourbusiness.com

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Your Resend API key with 'Sending access' only. Create one at resend.com, under API Keys.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Who emails come from, like: Joe's Bakery <accessibility@joesbakery.com>. The address must use a domain you've verified in Resend.

TIME_ZONE.description: Your time zone, like America/New_York or Europe/London. Times in the portal use it.
